# Write with Markdown

Quarto combines **formatted text**, tables, equations, and code in one document.
Edit this file, then run `quarto preview 01-basics.qmd` to see your changes.

## A simple list

1. Write your content in a `.qmd` file.
2. Preview it while you work.
3. Render a finished document to share.

## A table

| Format | Good for |
|:-------|:---------|
| HTML | Reading in a browser |
| PDF | Printing and fixed layouts |
| Word | Sharing editable documents |

# Add an equation

The mean of a set of observations is:

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i
$$

## Start small

This document has no executable code, so it only needs Quarto to render to HTML.
:::

An ordinary code fence displays code without running it:

```python
message = "Hello, Quarto!"
print(message)
```
